techniques_applied: Internal resolution reduction to 192x192 with fixed external (1,3,224,224) input
Structured final-feature channel pruning: 1280 to 640 channels, with dependent BN and classifier inputs removed
Classifier-only cross-entropy recovery on all 27000 images; FP32 weights and compute
ai_hub_profile_summary: No AI Hub compile/profile for this exact selected FP32 model. All submitted efficiency figures are laptop CPU measurements; older models' Hub profiles are not attributed to this model.
measurement_machine: AMD Ryzen 7 5800H with Radeon Graphics; 27.86 GiB RAM; Windows-10-10.0.19045-SP0; ONNX Runtime 1.31.0, CPUExecutionProvider, 4 threads, batch 1

measurement_details.schema_source: The Minimalist Edge AI Challenge.pdf, Section 8
measurement_details.baseline_role: Unchanged supplied MobileNetV2, measured locally under organizer own-laptop-baseline clarification
measurement_details.model_format: Uncompressed FP32 ONNX for both baseline and final
measurement_details.size_and_ram_units: MiB (2**20 bytes), matching the brief code despite its mb field labels
measurement_details.data_protocol: Organizer clarification: train and evaluate on all EuroSAT images; no held-out split
measurement_details.latency_statistic: Median of three per-run medians; 1000 timings after 100 warmups per fresh process
measurement_details.latency_input: One real preprocessed image repeated; accuracy measured separately on all 27000 images
measurement_details.benchmark_order: Serial fresh processes, rotating model order, no concurrent training
measurement_details.peak_ram_statistic: Maximum sampled process RSS across three repetitions
measurement_details.energy_scope: Process-attributed CPU TDP/load estimate plus estimated system RAM; GPU excluded; not a hardware meter reading
measurement_details.macs_note: THOP computation counts exclude the internal bilinear resize overhead
